summary.en: Validate offline social references and prevent citation evidence duplication.
summary.zh: 校验离线社交引用，避免引用重复计为新指控。

reason: Deterministic validation replaces the deferred local-model experiment.

compatibility.en: Legacy speech without metadata remains valid. Invalid future/private source references are rejected before live broadcast or restore mutation.
compatibility.zh: 兼容无元数据的旧发言；未来或私密引用在广播与恢复修改前被拒绝。
